title: 4，从一次性炮灰，变成资深炮灰！
slug: 人在俄乌当佣兵杀敌就能爆属性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

卡车整整开了一天一夜，最终在毛熊南部的克拉斯诺达尔边疆区，一座名叫莫利基诺训练基地的大门口停下。

这是瓦格纳最早，也最有名的训练基地。

更有意思的是，这地方旁边还挨着俄军总参谋部情报总局，也就是GRU旗下第十独立特种任务旅的驻地。

一个雇佣兵集团的训练营，建在GRU精锐部队旁边。

这事听起来很离谱，但很毛熊。

“所有人排队，枪口朝下！”

“谁敢乱指，老子先废了谁！”

一个满脸络腮胡的老兵站在众人面前，催促着囚犯们赶到泥泞的作训场上。

没人寒暄，没人欢迎，更没人关心他们累不累。

训练开始了！

沈飞原以为他们会接受到系统的堑壕作战的训练，但他很快意识到自己还是把毛熊想的太好了。

这帮人...

压根没有站在士兵角度出发，把他们当成个人。

第一个训练很简单。

教官掏出几卷彩色胶带，直接丢在泥地上。

白色、红色、黄色、蓝色，还有几卷边缘沾着泥的绿色胶带。

他用脚尖提了提胶带，对着众人说道，“在战场上，双方都穿迷彩，都拿卡拉什尼科夫，都趴在泥里，脏得像从同一个坑里爬出来。”

“所以，胶带就是你们分辨敌我的最好方式。”

“我们这边，常用白色、红色，敌人那边则是蓝色、黄色、绿色。”

“但是，别把这些颜色当圣经。”

“战场上，什么都会变，颜色就不一定看得清。”

“而且，敌人会换衣服，会故意混淆你们。”

“你们不需要像侦察兵一样聪明，只需要明白三件事。”

“第一，看胶带。”

“第二，听口令。”

“第三，不确定的时候，趴下喊人，别他妈自己当英雄。”

在他讲话的同时，几个瓦格纳士兵开始给囚犯们分胶带，每个人左臂缠一圈，钢盔上再贴一截。

刺啦刺啦的声音，在夜空中回荡着。

接下来是枪械基础。

AK-74M怎么上弹匣，保险在哪里，怎么确认枪膛，怎么别把手指一直扣在扳机上，怎么卧倒，怎么从泥里爬起来，怎么听见口令后往前冲。

没有花哨动作，没有帅气姿势，更没有电影里那种单手换弹、翻滚射击、战术清场。

只有最基础的东西。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The truck drove for a whole day and night, and finally stopped at the gate of a training base called Molikino in the Krasnodar Territory, south of Mao Xiong.

This is Wagner's earliest and most famous training base.

What's even more interesting is that this place is also next to the General Intelligence Directorate of the Russian General Staff, which is the headquarters of the 10th Independent Special Mission Brigade under the GRU.

A training camp for a mercenary group was built next to the elite GRU troops.

This thing sounds outrageous, but it is very bearish.

"Everyone line up, guns pointed down!"

"Whoever dares to point fingers, I will destroy him first!"

A bearded veteran stood in front of everyone, urging the prisoners to the muddy training ground.

No one greeted them, no one welcomed them, and no one cared whether they were tired or not.

Training begins!

Shen Fei originally thought that they would receive systematic trench warfare training, but he soon realized that he had thought too well of the bear.

These people...

It didn't take the soldiers' perspective at all and treat them as individuals.

The first training session is simple.

The instructor took out several rolls of colored tape and threw them directly on the dirt floor.

White, red, yellow, blue, and a few rolls of green tape with mud on the edges.

He lifted the tape with his toes and said to everyone, "On the battlefield, both sides wear camouflage, both carry Kalashnikovs, and both lie in the mud, as dirty as if they crawled out of the same pit."

"So, tape is the best way for you to distinguish between friend and foe."

"On our side, white and red are commonly used, while on the enemy's side, blue, yellow, and green are used."

“But don’t take these colors as a bible.”

"On the battlefield, everything changes, and colors may not be visible clearly."

"Moreover, the enemy will change clothes and deliberately confuse you."

"You don't need to be as smart as a scout, you just need to understand three things."

"First, look at the tape."

"Second, listen to the command."

"Third, when you're in doubt, get down and call someone. Don't be the fucking hero yourself."

While he was speaking, several Wagner soldiers began to distribute tape to the prisoners, wrapping a circle around each person's left arm and another piece on the helmet.

The sound of tingling tingling echoed in the night sky.

Next is the basics of firearms.

How to load the magazine of AK-74M, where is the safety, how to check the chamber, how not to keep your finger on the trigger, how to lie down, how to get up from the mud, and how to rush forward after hearing the command.

There are no fancy moves, no handsome postures, and no one-handed reloading, rolling shooting, or tactical clearing like in the movies.

Just the basics.
